4116722.title: Coal Mine Culture Festival, Sabuk
4116722.overview: A new festival in the old coal-mining town of Sabuk in Jeongseon, held for the first time in 2026 to mark the opening of the M650 museum. It tells the story of the miners who powered Korea’s industrialisation through a large-scale themed performance built on their lives, programmes from the seven former coal-mining towns of the region, and hands-on activities about the mines. Events run around the new M650 museum, the Ppuri Hall and 650 Street. Free.
4116722.place: M650 Museum, Ppuri Hall and 650 Street, Sabuk-eup, Jeongseon

2986930.title: Ulsan Industrial Festival
2986930.overview: Ulsan, the shipbuilding and car-making city, celebrates sixty years of industry from 8 to 11 October 2026 on the Nam-gu riverbank of the Taehwagang National Garden, under the theme ‘AX transformation, all in Ulsan’. An opening show weaves the city’s industrial history together with the thousand-year legend of Cheoyong, followed by a citizens’ festival, a university culture festival, AI technology experiences and a giant junk-art robot. Five local companies run their own booths, and there are local food stalls, chicken and beer and food trucks. Free.
2986930.place: Nam-gu riverbank, Taehwagang National Garden, Ulsan

4116779.title: Heritage Media Art Yeosu: Jinnamgwan
4116779.overview: A night-time media-art show telling the story of Admiral Yi Sun-sin and the Joseon navy’s left provincial headquarters at Yeosu, under the theme ‘Jinnamgwan, rebuilt in light’. From 9 October to 8 November 2026, projections on the great wooden hall of Jinnamgwan, the memorial pavilion and old trees of Gosodae, and the turtle ship in Yi Sun-sin Square bring to life his war diary, his care for the people and the voyages of the turtle ships. There is an AI ‘meta-human’ Yi Sun-sin, interactive content with visitors’ photos and a stamp tour, with activities and a flea market at weekends. Free.
4116779.place: Jinnamgwan, Gosodae and Yi Sun-sin Square, Yeosu

4116376.title: Imnang Wellness Festival, Gijang
4116376.overview: A wellness festival on Imnang Beach in Gijang, on the coast north of Busan, built around movement, rest and recovery by the sea. Visitors can join beach yoga, running, beach walks, meditation and breathing sessions, music-and-movement classes and wellness talks, choosing activities to suit their own energy, over an eve-of-festival night and the main days. Free.

1726052.title: German Village Beer Festival, Namhae
1726052.overview: Namhae’s German Village was built for Koreans who went to West Germany as miners and nurses in the 1960s and 1970s and later came home, and its 14th beer festival is modelled on Oktoberfest. Expect German-style food and beer, music, parades and activities, with the history of the Korean workers in Germany woven through the programme, set against the village’s red roofs above the sea on Namhae Island. Free entry.

2846034.title: Anyang Youth Festival
2846034.overview: A one-day festival for young people in Pyeongchon Central Park, Anyang, on 10 October 2026, under the slogan ‘Youth is purple’: the colour of the city, made of red passion and blue rest. There are exhibition, information and activity booths, performances by young local artists, a celebration concert and the city’s youth awards. Free.

2987791.title: DMZ OPEN Festival 2026
2987791.overview: Gyeonggi Province’s festival of the Demilitarised Zone, presenting the border not only as a place of division but as a preserved natural landscape, a historic site and a symbol of possible peace. Rather than a single event, it is a season of programmes across art, talks, sport and walking that let visitors walk, listen to and experience the DMZ, centred on the Imjingak area in Paju. Free, with some paid programmes.

3544911.title: Subongsan Festival, Incheon
3544911.overview: Michuhol-gu’s neighbourhood festival on Subongsan, a wooded hill in central Incheon, held since 2021. Outdoor concerts by local artists and invited headliners, family activities, an art flea market, exhibitions and a food zone fill the park around the artificial waterfall for an afternoon and evening. Free.
3544911.place: Artificial waterfall area, Subong Park, Incheon

4116560.title: Seoul Animal Happiness Festa
4116560.overview: Seoul’s animal-welfare festival for its Animal Protection Day, on 17 and 18 October 2026 in front of the Mulbit Stage at Yeouido Hangang Park, for pet owners and everyone else. Highlights include a dog-and-owner run along the Han River, a live pet-advice talk with a well-known vet, stories from adopted dogs and their families, and an adoption ‘red carpet’ for rescue animals. There is also an animal-welfare play zone, behaviour and health advice, pet registration and photo spots. Free except the run.
4116560.fee: Animal Happiness Run ₩10,000; all other programmes free

4116824.title: Yeongdeungpo Future Talent Science Festival
4116824.overview: A one-day science festival for children, teenagers and their families in Yeongdeungpo Park, Seoul, on 17 October 2026, with virtual-reality experiences, AI demonstrations, robot performances and hands-on science booths laid out around the park. Free.

1720025.title: Dasan Jeong Yak-yong Cultural Festival
1720025.overview: Namyangju’s festival of Jeong Yak-yong (Dasan), the great reformist scholar of late Joseon, held for the 40th time on 17 and 18 October 2026 at his birthplace and the Dasan Ecological Park by the Han River. It opens with a flower and tea offering, followed by an anniversary fashion show by designer Lie Sang-bong on the 17th and a concert with Urban Zakapa and others on the 18th. There are treasure hunts, a ‘digital detox in exile’ experience, AI and robot workshops, traditional games, hanbok and busking. Free.
1720025.place: Jeong Yak-yong Historic Site and Dasan Ecological Park, Namyangju

4116994.title: K-Drone Festival, Gangneung
4116994.overview: A drone industry festival at Gangneung Olympic Park, held alongside the 2026 ITS World Congress in Gangneung, with exhibitions on Korea’s drone technology and policy, hands-on activities for families, a drone light show on the evening of Monday 19 October and a drone delivery demonstration on Thursday 22 October. Free.
4116994.sponsor: Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport

3370452.title: Suseong International Biennale 2026
3370452.overview: An international architecture and landscape biennale in Daegu’s Suseong district, from 27 October to 22 November 2026, on the theme ‘Living Ground’. Korean and international architects and landscape designers create projects in real city spaces, the parks, the lake and empty plots around Suseongmot, alongside exhibitions, forums and participatory programmes. Free.

4116358.title: Miryang Spicy Food Festival
4116358.overview: Miryang is where the famous Buldak fire noodles are made and where the local Matnahyang chillies grow, and its festival is a celebration of Korean spice. On the Miryang riverbank there are chef’s tables, a spicy zone and a cool-down zone, spice challenges, a ‘fill the Scoville scale’ game, and brand experience zones from Samyang and other food companies, with performances throughout. Free.

4116982.title: Sanbuk AI Kimjang Festival, Yeoju
4116982.overview: The 22nd Sanbuk Pumsil Festival in Yeoju is themed around kimjang, the communal making of winter kimchi that UNESCO listed as intangible cultural heritage in 2013. Visitors can join in making kimchi with fresh produce from the local farms, with new technology added to make it easy for anyone to take part. Free entry.
